mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days in monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%) triggers central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20d returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary regime (UNRATE > 5.5%), a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE rising > 0.2pp) signals deteriorating labor conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5% and UNRATE rising > 0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS rising) consistently boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when PAYEMS is rising.

mechanism_narrative: Falling housing starts (HOUST < 500.0) signal a weakening housing market, reducing consumer confidence and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 40% of instances when HOUST < 500.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signal supply shock and monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining INDPRO and rising FEDFUNDS fails to produce negative 20d returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained regime (INDPRO < 90.0), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals ongoing supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 90.0 and INDPRO declining.
